test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the correctly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is** Deceive.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The correctly spelt word is **Deceive.**
 
• The other three words given in the option are **misspelt.**
 
• Thus the correct answer is** Deceive.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****

__
 
• **Deceive** means **deliberately causing (someone) to believe something that is not true.**
 
• The synonym of the given is a **swindle, defraud, cheat, trick **etc. 
 
• The antonyms of the given word **advise, undeceive**, **interact.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Other Options-__****Correct Spellings-**

 
• Exceptionale- Exceptional
 
• Mortle- Mortal
